# My Neuro Health

My Neuro Health is a UK neurodevelopmental healthcare brand.

Current public service:
- Adult ADHD assessment

Coming soon:
- Child ADHD assessment

Primary website: https://myneurohealth.co.uk/
Adult ADHD: https://myneurohealth.co.uk/adult-adhd.html
How it works: https://myneurohealth.co.uk/how-it-works.html
About: https://myneurohealth.co.uk/about.html

The public website does not currently advertise autism assessment or in-house ADHD medication treatment.
